notesStmt.note: Whitman planned to write an essay about Elias Hicks for many years. While finishing preparations for the printing of November Boughs, Whitman told Horace Traubel, "Some of these bits were written as many as thirty years ago. Some of them I have written within the past year. They are a miscellaneous lot but they all belong in the same stream." (See Traubel, With Walt Whitman in Camden, 2:42). It is therefore difficult to determine the exact date of the present manuscript, although the handwriting suggests a date in the 1870s or 1880s.
These manuscript notes contributed to "Elias Hicks, Notes (such as they are)," which was first published in November Boughs (1888) and later reprinted in Complete Prose Works (1892).
